title: Stained Glass Selfie
description: A vibrant stained glass artwork depicting a woman in a white and purple bikini sitting cross-legged on a bed while taking a selfie with her smartphone. The composition is framed by a heart-shaped stained glass border containing a sunny European street scene with cafes, a domed building, trees, and orange flowers below.
prompt: A highly detailed stained glass mosaic with thick black leading, showing a fit young woman in a lavender and white bikini sitting cross-legged on white sheets taking a mirror selfie with an iPhone. She wears a black and white patterned bandana. The heart-shaped central panel reveals a bright sunny European cobblestone street lined with cafes, colorful awnings, and a large domed building in the distance under a radiant sun. Orange flowers in the bottom panel, warm vibrant color palette.
